en.t: “The withered petals are floating on the pond.

units.source_text: 山中翠绿丛中，有一两棵没有凋谢，

en.t: Among the lush green thickets in the mountains, one or two trees have not yet withered,

units.source_text: 从稍远的地方望去，反而别有一番风味啊。”

en.t: and when you look at them from a little distance, they have a charm all their own.”
